title: Store collaboration records on a private branch
responsibility: Build a repository adapter that reads validated records and updates their branch with compare-and-swap writes.

inputs.name: createGitHubRepository.options
inputs.description: Configuration consumed by githubTransport and this adapter to select a repository, records ref, and path. It is used for reads and compare-and-swap writes; creation requires repository.private and a ref starting with refs/heads/, while the ref and path must pass validation.

outputs.name: createGitHubRepository
outputs.description: A CollaborationRepository with read and compareAndSwap methods for this GitHub ref. read returns an all-zero SHA and empty records if the ref is absent, or the ref SHA and empty records if the file is absent; compare-and-swap returns null for a changed ref and the confirmed commit SHA after a successful write.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised for invalid configuration or failed GitHub operations, including a non-private repository, an invalid ref or path, invalid records, unavailable GitHub, or an unconfirmed ref update. A stale compare-and-swap returns null instead of throwing.
